## Operator intent (overrides the auto-generated "Why" template below)

We are NOT flipping to Alpaca-mirror mode — `BROKER_PAPER` remains `sim`,
the validated interim per memory note `project_alpaca_moc_blocker.md`.

This reset was run to clear the 7-row `PENDING_BROKER` breadcrumb backlog
accumulated 2026-05-18 → 2026-05-22 (while a prior session had
`BROKER_PAPER=alpaca` enabled). Those breadcrumb rows had no terminal
mirror-back companions, so `paper_sim.pending_broker_count()` returned 7
indefinitely and tripped Guard-1 on every routine since — the CB equity
write has been skipped for the last ~15 sessions. The structural fix
(a symmetric `confirm_broker_fills()` finalizer + an `order_id` exclusion
in `pending_broker_count()`) merged in
[#58](https://github.com/pmehaboobkhan/calm_turtle/pull/58) earlier today
(commit `a58cb74`). This script run is the one-time historical cleanup of
the existing backlog; the finalizer prevents recurrence going forward.

  peak reached pre-2026-05-29 de-risk) down to current Alpaca equity

- No Alpaca-side changes: 0 open orders to cancel, 0 positions to close.
